title: openagents worktree ls takes ~30 s with 32 worktrees
body: From #10294 (eeae76ff5a): `openagents worktree ls --no-size` takes ~30 s on the Mac because the unsaved check runs git serially across 32 worktrees. Run checks in parallel (bounded), use cheaper git calls (`git status --porcelain=v2 -z --ignored=matching` once per worktree, skip ignored scan for ls unless asked), and show rows as they arrive. Target < 3 s for 32 worktrees. Same for the terminal's /worktrees.
